gaps.explanation: 'Applause' is the noun; 'applaud' is the verb.

gaps.sentence: The trainers were ___ (COMFORT) for long walks.
gaps.explanation: 'Were comfortable' — adjective; note the spelling: -able, not -ible.

gaps.sentence: The report was highly ___ (CRITIC) of the new scheme.
gaps.explanation: 'Highly critical of' — the adjective describing a judgement.

gaps.sentence: She's a leading ___ (SCIENCE) in climate research.
He made a full ___ (RECOVER) after six months.
Send your ___ (APPLY) to the address below.
gaps.explanation: 'Your application' — the document you send; an applicant is a person.

gaps.sentence: With careful ___ (PREPARE), the trek is perfectly safe.
